title: Released LucyPlanner, a macOS day planner
description: Built and open-sourced LucyPlanner, a small macOS app I made because no existing planner kept my daily goal, time table, todos, and habits all on one screen. It's SwiftUI + SwiftData under the hood, integrates with Apple Calendar via EventKit, and includes a lightweight Eisenhower matrix view for triaging what's actually urgent versus what just feels loud. Source, download, and setup notes at github.com/yahyunee/LucyPlanner.

title: 2026 ALCF INCITE GPU Hackathon
description: Spent three days at Argonne with team DIVER, working with ALCF mentors to scale our code on Aurora, Polaris, and the AI Testbeds in preparation for our INCITE proposal. Gave both the kickoff and final presentations, learned a ton about distributed GPU workflows, and met an incredible group of researchers from across the country.

title: Started VSRC at Princeton University
description: Began my time at Princeton University as a Visiting Student Research Collaborator (VSRC) from April through September 2026. Excited to dive into new research, meet the people here, and make the most of these six months on campus.
